description_en: Gets a list of DDoS attack events
description_zh: 该接口用于查询DDoS攻击事件列表
name: DescribeDDoSAllEventList

parameters.help_en:
The start time of the query.

The time must be in ISO 8601 format and in UTC. Format: `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`
parameters.help_zh:
查询的起始时间。

日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC+0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end time of the query.

The time must be in ISO 8601 format and in UTC. Format: `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`. The time range between `StartTime` and `EndTime` cannot exceed 31 days.

If this parameter is not specified, it defaults to the current time
parameters.help_zh:
查询的结束时间。

日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC+0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。
开始结束时间跨度最长不超过31天。

不设置该参数表示选取当前时间作为查询的结束时间
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The type of DDoS attack events to query. Valid values:

web-cc: A web resource exhaustion attack.

cc: A connection-based attack.

traffic: A traffic-based attack.

If you do not specify this parameter, the operation queries `web-cc` events by default
parameters.help_zh:
待查询的DDoS攻击事件的类型。取值：
web-cc：表示Web资源耗尽型攻击。
cc：表示连接型攻击。
traffic：表示流量型攻击。

不设置该参数表示查询Web资源耗尽型攻击事件
parameters.name: event_type

parameters.help_en: The page number to return. Valid range: 1 to 100000
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. Valid values: 5, 10, and 20
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The ID of the site. You can obtain this ID by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850189.html operation
parameters.name: site_id

DataList.description_en: A list of DDoS attack event details

items.description_en: Details of a DDoS attack event

Bps.description_en: The peak bits per second (Bps) of a volumetric attack

Coverage.description_en:
The attack region. Valid values:

domestic: Chinese mainland.

global: Global.

overseas: global (excluding Chinese mainland)
Coverage.description_zh:
攻击区域。取值：

domestic：仅中国内地。
global：全球。
overseas：全球（不包含中国内地）

Cps.description_en: The peak connections per second (Cps) of a connection-based attack

EndTime.description_en:
The end time of the DDoS attack event.

The time is in the `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` format and is in UTC
EndTime.description_zh:
DDoS攻击事件的结束时间。

日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC+0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ

EventResult.description_en:
The event result. Valid values:

clean: The attack was successfully cleaned.

ratelimit: Rate limiting was applied.

blackhole: Blackhole filtering was triggered
EventResult.description_zh:
事件结果。取值：

clean：成功清洗。
ratelimit：限速。
blackhole：黑洞

EventType.description_en:
The type of the DDoS attack event. Valid values:

web-cc: A web resource exhaustion attack.

cc: A connection-based attack.

traffic: A volumetric attack
EventType.description_zh:
待查询的DDoS攻击事件的类型。取值：
web-cc：表示Web资源耗尽型攻击。
cc：表示连接型攻击。
traffic：表示流量型攻击

Pps.description_en: The peak packets per second (Pps) of a volumetric attack

Qps.description_en: The peak queries per second (Qps) of a web resource exhaustion attack

StartTime.description_en:
The start time of the DDoS attack event.

The time is in the `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` format and is in UTC
StartTime.description_zh:
DDoS攻击事件的起始时间。

日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC+0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ

TargetId.description_en: The ID of the attack target

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
